name: Cardigan Mountain School Summer Session
description_short: Coed summer school and camp on a 525 acre lakeside boarding school campus in Canaan, for boarding and day students aged 8 to 15. Mornings are small academic and enrichment classes; afternoons, evenings and weekends bring hiking, mountain biking, paddling, tennis, drama and camping trips.
swim_waterfront_notes: Students swim in the lake beside campus with an adult lifeguard. Everyone takes a swim test, and those who do not pass join the school's swim program until they have basic water safety skills. Boating, canoeing and kayaking are supervised by faculty.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page; 2027 tuition for domestic boarding and day students; tuition includes dorm, classes, meals, activities and weekend trips; airport shuttle from Logan ($125) and JFK ($235) each way; about 30% of students get aid

source.title: Dates, Rates, and Financial Aid - Cardigan Mountain School

warnings: International boarding students pay more: $9,900 for four weeks and $5,150 for two weeks, plus a $125 application fee. Domestic first time students pay a $50 application fee.
An expense deposit ($500 boarding, $250 day) is charged on top of tuition and returned if unused.
This is an academic summer session with camp activities. Students apply and are admitted.
